// 24 entries cannot hold round(stock * 3) in its field - each needs a
// clamp (accepting a tighter-than-ideal value) or a runtime pin.

// --- SHARED FACTORY CONSTANTS (one site, EVERY caller) ---
//   TextLabel wrap/anchor width = 1000 at 0x77971A (push_imm32, in 0x779660)
//       SetArea(l=r.right,t=r.top,r=1000,b=r.bottom)
//       SHARED by all 86 TextLabel sites - align-6 labels position at x-windowWidth, so a blind change shifts every right-aligned column
//       Scope per call site (detour) or not at all
//       (BUDGET-DETAIL-ANATOMY §POPUP Q2)
//   Combo width = 120 at 0x77992F (lea_disp8, in 0x7798C0)
//       lea edi,[edx+0x78]
//       disp8 CEILING 127 -> 2x (240) CANNOT be encoded in place; shipped as a runtime width pin in UiSpike.
//   Combo height = 15 at 0x779927 (lea_disp8, in 0x7798C0)
//       lea edx,[ecx+0xf]
//       Same disp8 limit; 2x (30) DOES fit.
//   Slider height = 14 at 0x779548 (lea_disp8, in 0x7794E0)
//       lea edx,[ecx+0xe]
//       Shared by all 4 Slider sites; 2x (28) fits
